Spill cleanup services in Canada

Every national service page below covers one response type—emergency containment, chemical cleanup, fuel recovery, hazmat, or soil remediation. Start with the closest match; if you have free product on pavement and stained soil, tell dispatch on the same call so we stage absorbents and excavation support. Plant managers, fleets, and property owners share one Canada-wide line—share your address, product SDS, and nearest storm drain.

Services FAQ

01

Containment vs full remediation—which comes first?

Active releases get berms and recovery first. Soil remediation follows delineation and sampling when contamination spread beyond the pad.

02

Can one visit cover fuel and hydraulic oil?

Often yes—describe every product involved so we bring compatible PPE, absorbents, and waste containers.

03

How do I book?

Pick the closest service below, then call 1-888-XXX-XXXX with your site address and photos of the release.
